title: Antenatal Corticosteroid in Elective Cesarean Section
brief_summary: Caesarean section is a risk factor for the development of neonatal respiratory complications, mostly respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) and transient tachypnoea of the new-born, both in term and preterm infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Maternal age (18-35 years)
* Singleton pregnancy
* Gestational age (38-40 years)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Major maternal morbidities as DM and pre-eclampsia
* Sever oligohydramnios
* Premature rupture of membranes
* Women who receive steroids during pregnancy
